issues.detail: Threads TH2 (14 messages), TH3 (13 messages), and TH5 (11 messages) fall below the minimum expected 16 messages per thread. Additionally, they do not meet the blueprint target_messages_range.
Task T7 is listed in artifacts_to_reference for TH3 in the blueprint, but it is never referenced in the artifact_refs of any message in TH3.
